Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7466); Ragau (i.e. Reu), a patriarch:--Ragau.
BiblicalUsage: Ragau stands in the genealogy of Jesus, the son of Phalec and the father of Saruch, the Reu of the old line from Shem to Abraham. The Greek text behind the King James Version spells the name with a circumflex, while the text I have checked spells it Ῥαγαύ.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the genealogy keeps even the quietest links, and Ragau is there because the chain has no missing piece.
